key_insight: CIDERS turns cloud-edge LLM collaboration into a personalized bilevel optimization problem, using consensus-corrected local updates to balance global knowledge sharing with edge-specific adaptation.
engineering_relevance: The method provides a practical blueprint for deploying LLMs on cloud-edge systems where communication is constrained but both shared performance and domain personalization are required.
method: Splits the system into a learnable backbone and a messenger for efficient cloud-to-edge knowledge transfer.
Injects global trajectory information into each local step via consensus-variate correction.
Provides convergence analysis and a geometric view of local trajectories to explain the personalization–consensus trade-off.
evidence_signal: Experiments on compressed edge settings report 3.1× gains for mathematical reasoning, 1.7× gains for code generation, and a 10% relative improvement on instruction metrics over baselines.
watch_item: The approach adds optimization and coordination complexity, so its stability and communication overhead may be sensitive to edge-device resource limits.
paper_title: CIDERS: Cloud-Edge LLM Collaborative Learning via Accelerating Personalized Bilevel Optimization
